body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-19 12:52Z; Engram::Fable caught this in the w-edb79ddbf033 final-diff audit, #3572). Condition (b) of the authority-change rule (Greg has been sent the exact wording and its consequence) must be met with THIS project's own final wording. A notice that carried the twin project's text does not count, even when the only differences are role names: Engram's "Engram::Merger" versus TermAl's "the integration owner (as of 2026-10-19: Termal::Opus2)". The fix was a separate notice of the exact TermAl bullet via Engram Advisor #1810 (12:50:45Z), checked equal to bullet.md. For every cross-project authority twin, send Greg each project's exact text, or confirm one notice quotes both, before the audit.
